+	}

+	mat.instantiate();
+

+	CHECK_MESSAGE(mat->get_roughness() == doctest::Approx(1.0f), "Default roughness should be 1.0");
+	CHECK_MESSAGE(mat->get_metallic() == doctest::Approx(0.0f), "Default metallic should be 0.0");

body:
I don't think we should have this check in every test case. Instead, we should just skip running this test suite entirely in builds that don't have BaseMaterial3D (instead of printing a warning). You should be able to achieve this by surrounding all test cases with `#ifndef _3D_DISABLED`.

The same applies to StandardMaterial3D below.
The file should be renamed to `test_orm_material_3d.h`. (I know the unit test creation script calls it `test_o_r_m_material_3d.h`, but we should probably find a way to improve that.)
